info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Legal Advisory Engagements API
info.description: The Legal Advisory Engagements API allows businesses to establish and manage legal advisory engagements efficiently. This endpoint facilitates the creation of new engagements between enterprises and legal advisors, ensuring that all necessary details are captured accurately. Typical consumers include legal departments and compliance teams looking to streamline the engagement process and enhance collaboration with external legal counsel. The API supports industry-specific requirements and documentation standards for legal advisory services.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new legal advisory engagement, capturing relevant details and requirements necessary for legal assistance. Properly formatted inputs are required to ensure successful engagement creation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a new engagement with the legal advisory service. It requires specific details about the engagement, including relevant legal contexts and parties involved.

201.description: The engagement has been successfully created.
